/-- A step of `Reachable` keeps the authorities (MM-03.3 §3–6). -/
theorem step_keeps {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : Step k s s') : KeepsAuth s s' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk => exact kstep_keeps hk
  | newArena hs => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs; exact .same rfl
  | issue hs =>
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hst =>
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, e⟩ := issue_ok_iff.1 hst
      have e1 := congrArg Prod.fst e; simp only at e1; subst e1
      exact .app rfl
  | reset hs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold resetAtEff; split <;> exact .same rfl

/-- The places of `s` remain in `s'` with their footprint. -/
def FpStable (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  s.P.length ≤ s'.P.length ∧ ∀ q < s.P.length, ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q

theorem FpStable.same {s s₁ : S3} (h : s₁.P = s.P) : FpStable s s₁ :=
  ⟨by rw [h]; exact Nat.le_refl _, fun _ _ _ => by rw [h]⟩
...
    cases hs with
    | ok _ hst =>
      obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, e⟩ := issue_ok_iff.1 hst
      have e1 := congrArg Prod.fst e; simp only at e1; subst e1
      exact .same rfl
  | reset hs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 hs
    unfold resetAtEff; split <;> exact .same rfl

/-- `Reachable` is closed under its steps (MM-03.3 §10, `Step`). -/
theorem reachable_step {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} (hr : Reachable k statics s)
    (h : Step k s s') : Reachable k statics s' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk =>
    cases hk with
    | derive hs => exact .derive hr hs
    | split hs => exact .split hr hs
    | release hs => exact .release hr hs
    | transfer hs => exact .transfer hr hs
    | depend hs => exact .depend hr hs
    | enter hs => exact .enter hr hs
    | exit hs => exact .exit hr hs
    | read hs => exact .read hr hs
    | write hs => exact .write hr hs
    | writeShared hs => exact .writeShared hr hs
    | pin hs => exact .pin hr hs
    | unpin hs => exact .unpin hr hs
    | endUse hs => exact .endUse hr hs
    | free hs => exact .free hr hs
    | alloc hs => exact .alloc hr hs
    | store hs => exact .store hr hs
  | newArena hs => exact .newArena hr hs
  | issue hs => exact .issue hr hs
  | reset hs => exact .reset hr hs

/-- Finite sequences of steps of `Reachable`. -/
inductive Steps (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | refl (s : S3) : Steps k s s
  | tail {s s₁ s₂ : S3} : Steps k s s₁ → Step k s₁ s₂ → Steps k s s₂

theorem Steps.keeps {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : Steps k s s') : KeepsAuth s s' := by
...
    · rename_i hpre
      exact (Steps.single (.kernel (.release (Guarded.ok hpre)))).trans (releaseAll_steps h)
    · cases h

/-- Every pool step is a finite sequence of steps of `Reachable` on the kernel state (material §4:
the pool is built on `derive`, `split`, `release`, `endUse`, and the handle is written by
`write3`). `WF3` and `I3` give the valid anchors of the write of `allocSlot`. -/
theorem pstep_steps {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} (hw : WF3 ps.s) (h3 : I3 ps.s) (h : PStep k ps ps') :
    Steps k ps.s ps'.s := by
  cases h with
  | kernel h => exact .single h
  | newPool h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact .refl _
  | allocSlot h =>
    cases h with
    | ok _ hst _ _ =>
      obtain ⟨-, hu, hr, hl, -, -⟩ := hst
      obtain ⟨a, hw3⟩ := write_of_right hw h3 hu hr hl
      exact .single (.kernel (.write (a := a) (Guarded.ok hw3)))
  | resolve h =>
    cases h with
    | ok _ hR _ _ hE =>
      exact (Steps.single (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok hR)))).tail
        (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok hE)))
  | resolveMany h =>
    cases h with
    | ok _ hR _ hS =>
      exact (Steps.single (.kernel (.derive (Guarded.ok hR)))).tail
        (.kernel (.split (Guarded.ok hS)))
  | unresolve h =>
    cases h with
    | ok _ hr => exact releaseAll_steps hr
  | freeSlot h =>
    cases h with
    | ok _ _ _ _ _ hE => exact .single (.kernel (.endUse (Guarded.ok hE)))

/-- Integration with `Reachable` (material §4): the kernel state of every state reached with pool
steps is reached by kernel and arena steps (MM-03.3 §10). Under `DDSound k`, used by the invariants
that give the anchors of the write of `allocSlot`. -/
theorem pReach_reachable {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {ps : PS}
    (h : PReach k statics ps) : Reachable k statics ps.s := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh => exact .init hsh
  | step _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hw, hinv, -⟩ := reachable_invariants hdd ih
    exact reachable_steps ih (pstep_steps hw hinv.1.2.2.1 hs)

/-! ## List helpers -/

theorem mem_set_self' {α : Type} : ∀ {l : List α} {i : Nat} {a x : α}, l[i]? = some a →
    x ∈ l.set i x
  | [], _, _, _, h => by simp at h
...
/-! ## Invariants of the pool layer -/

/-- Identity, storage, `internal` and entry places of a pool: what `allocSlot` and `freeSlot`
keep. -/
def Pool.shape (pl : Pool) : Nat × Nat × Nat × List Nat :=
  (pl.id, pl.storage, pl.internal, pl.slots.map (·.place))

theorem setSlot_shape {pl : Pool} {i : Nat} {sl x : Slot} (hs : pl.slots[i]? = some sl)
    (hx : x.place = sl.place) : (setSlot pl i x).shape = pl.shape := by
  simp only [Pool.shape, setSlot, map_set_same (·.place) hs hx]

theorem shape_mem {l l' : List Pool} (h : l'.map Pool.shape = l.map Pool.shape) {pl : Pool}
    (hpl : pl ∈ l) : ∃ pl' ∈ l', pl'.shape = pl.shape := by
  have : pl.shape ∈ l'.map Pool.shape := h ▸ List.mem_map_of_mem hpl
  obtain ⟨pl', h1, h2⟩ := List.mem_map.1 this
  exact ⟨pl', h1, h2⟩

theorem shape_ids {l l' : List Pool} (h : l'.map Pool.shape = l.map Pool.shape) :
    l'.map (·.id) = l.map (·.id) := by
  have := congrArg (List.map Prod.fst) h
  simpa [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, Pool.shape] using this

theorem shape_slot {pl pl' : Pool} (h : pl'.shape = pl.shape) {n : Nat} {sl : Slot}
    (hs : pl.slots[n]? = some sl) : ∃ sl', pl'.slots[n]? = some sl' ∧ sl'.place = sl.place := by
  have h4 : pl'.slots.map (·.place) = pl.slots.map (·.place) := by
    simp only [Pool.shape, Prod.mk.injEq] at h; exact h.2.2.2
  have := congrArg (·[n]?) h4
  simp only [List.getElem?_map, hs, Option.map_some] at this
  cases h' : pl'.slots[n]? with
  | none => rw [h'] at this; cases this
  | some sl' => rw [h'] at this; exact ⟨sl', rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩

theorem shape_place {pl pl' : Pool} (h : pl'.shape = pl.shape) {sl' : Slot} (hs : sl' ∈ pl'.slots) :
    ∃ sl ∈ pl.slots, sl.place = sl'.place := by
  have h4 : pl'.slots.map (·.place) = pl.slots.map (·.place) := by
    simp only [Pool.shape, Prod.mk.injEq] at h; exact h.2.2.2
  have : sl'.place ∈ pl.slots.map (·.place) := h4 ▸ List.mem_map_of_mem hs
  obtain ⟨sl, h1, h2⟩ := List.mem_map.1 this
  exact ⟨sl, h1, h2⟩

/-- Ghost well-formedness of the pool layer, kept by every step (`pReach_inv`): pool identities
fresh and distinct (material §4); `internal` a `Modify` authority (F1, through `newArena`); storage
and entries existing places; each resolution of an existing pool, with a companion created after
`internal`, of the mode of the resolution, on the footprint of the storage, and entry authorities
on the footprint of their entry, still derived while active. -/
def PoolWF (ps : PS) : Prop :=
  (∀ pl ∈ ps.pools, pl.id < ps.nId) ∧ (ps.pools.map (·.id)).Nodup ∧
  (∀ pl ∈ ps.pools, OptP (ps.s.A[pl.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify) False ∧
    pl.storage < ps.s.P.length ∧ ∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, sl.place < ps.s.P.length) ∧
  ∀ r ∈ ps.res, ∃ pl ∈ ps.pools, pl.id = r.pool ∧ pl.internal = r.internal ∧
    r.internal < r.comp ∧
    OptP (ps.s.A[r.comp]?) (fun y => y.mode = r.mode ∧
      ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P pl.storage) False ∧
    ∀ e ∈ r.entries, ∃ sl, pl.slots[e.2.1]? = some sl ∧
      OptP (ps.s.A[e.1]?) (fun y => (∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl.place) ∧
        (y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none)) False

/-- `pool_no_stale_access` as a state predicate (material §4, `PoolInv` second clause for the entry
authorities): an active entry authority carries the current generation of its entry, which is
live. -/
def NoStale (ps : PS) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ ps.res, ∀ e ∈ r.entries, ps.s.Active e.1 → ∃ pl ∈ ps.pools, pl.id = r.pool ∧
    ∃ sl, pl.slots[e.2.1]? = some sl ∧ sl.gen = e.2.2 ∧ sl.live = true

/-- Exclusivity of the companions (material §4, `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive`): two distinct
active companions of a pool are both `Observe`. -/
def CompExcl (ps : PS) : Prop :=
  ∀ r₁ ∈ ps.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ ps.res, r₁.pool = r₂.pool → r₁.comp ≠ r₂.comp →
    ps.s.Active r₁.comp → ps.s.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .observe ∧ r₂.mode = .observe

/-- `PoolWF` carries over a change of the kernel state that keeps authorities and footprints and a
change of pools that keeps their shape. -/
theorem PoolWF.transport {ps : PS} {s' : S3} {pools' : List Pool} (h : PoolWF ps)
    (hk : KeepsAuth ps.s s') (hf : FpStable ps.s s')
    (hp : pools'.map Pool.shape = ps.pools.map Pool.shape) :
    PoolWF ⟨s', pools', ps.nId, ps.res⟩ := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun pl' hpl' => ?_, by rw [shape_ids hp]; exact h2, fun pl' hpl' => ?_, fun r hr => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨pl, hpl, e⟩ := shape_mem hp.symm hpl'
    have := h1 pl hpl
    simp only [Pool.shape, Prod.mk.injEq] at e; rw [← e.1]; exact this
  · obtain ⟨pl, hpl, e⟩ := shape_mem hp.symm hpl'
    obtain ⟨hi, hst, hsl⟩ := h3 pl hpl
    have e' := e; simp only [Pool.shape, Prod.mk.injEq] at e'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hm⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hi
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hm', -⟩ := hk.get hy
    refine ⟨optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y', by rw [← e'.2.2.1]; exact hy', hm'.trans hm⟩,
      Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (e'.2.1 ▸ hst) hf.1, fun sl' hsl' => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨sl, hs, hp'⟩ := shape_place e.symm hsl'
    exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (hp' ▸ hsl sl hs) hf.1
  · obtain ⟨pl, hpl, hid, hint, hlt, hc, he⟩ := h4 r hr
    obtain ⟨pl', hpl', e⟩ := shape_mem hp hpl
    have e' := e; simp only [Pool.shape, Prod.mk.injEq] at e'
    obtain ⟨-, hst, hsl⟩ := h3 pl hpl
    refine ⟨pl', hpl', e'.1.trans hid, e'.2.2.1.trans hint, hlt, ?_, fun en hen => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hm, hfp⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hc
      obtain ⟨y', hy', hm', hf', -⟩ := hk.get hy
      refine optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y', hy', hm'.trans hm, fun l => ?_⟩
      rw [hf', e'.2.1]; exact (hfp l).trans (hf.2 _ hst l).symm
    · obtain ⟨sl, hs, ho⟩ := he en hen
      obtain ⟨sl', hs', hpl''⟩ := shape_slot e hs
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hfp, hor⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 ho
      obtain ⟨y', hy', -, hf', ha⟩ := hk.get hy
      refine ⟨sl', hs', optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y', hy', fun l => ?_, fun hya => ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [hf', hpl'']
        exact (hfp l).trans (hf.2 _ (hsl sl (List.mem_of_getElem? hs)) l).symm
      · exact (ha hya).2 (hor (ha hya).1)

theorem NoStale.transport {ps : PS} {s' : S3} (h : NoStale ps) (hw : PoolWF ps)
    (hk : KeepsAuth ps.s s') : NoStale { ps with s := s' } := by
  intro r hr e he ha
  obtain ⟨pl, _, _, _, _, _, hen⟩ := hw.2.2.2 r hr
  obtain ⟨sl, _, ho⟩ := hen e he
  obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 ho
  exact h r hr e he (hk.active (lt_of_getElem? hy) ha)

theorem CompExcl.transport {ps : PS} {s' : S3} (h : CompExcl ps) (hw : PoolWF ps)
    (hk : KeepsAuth ps.s s') : CompExcl { ps with s := s' } := by
  intro r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp hne ha₁ ha₂
  have lt : ∀ r ∈ ps.res, r.comp < ps.s.A.length := fun r hr => by
    obtain ⟨pl, _, _, _, _, hc, _⟩ := hw.2.2.2 r hr
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hc
    exact lt_of_getElem? hy
  exact h r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp hne (hk.active (lt r₁ hr₁) ha₁) (hk.active (lt r₂ hr₂) ha₂)

/-! ## Preservation by each step -/

/-- An active descendant of `z` covering `l` takes the effective `Modify` on `l` away from `z`
(MM-03.3.5, cases 3 and 4). -/
theorem not_allows_modify_of_desc {s : S3} {j z l : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[j]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) (hl : l ∈ y.footprint)
    (hz : z ∈ s.ancs j) : ¬ Allows (effective s z l) .modify := by
  have hd : y.mode ∈ descModes s z l := mem_descModes.2 ⟨j, y, hy, ya, hl, hz, rfl⟩
  have hne : descModes s z l ≠ [] := fun h => by rw [h] at hd; cases hd
  unfold effective
  split
  · split
    · simp only [effOf, hne, ↓reduceIte]
      split
      · exact id
      · intro h; rcases h with h | h <;> cases h
    · exact id
  · exact id

/-- At the creation of a companion (material §4, `resolve`), every active companion of the same
pool and the new one are both `Observe`: an active companion is unrelated to `internal`, which I1
excludes since `internal` is `Modify`, or descends from it, which takes away the effective mode
that the `derive` of the new companion requires (MM-03.3.5; MM-03.3 §2, I1; O1). -/
theorem companion_blocks {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hi1 : I1 s) {pl : Pool} {m : Mode}
    (hR : ResolveRight s pl m) {xi : Authority} (hxi : s.A[pl.internal]? = some xi)
    (hmi : xi.mode = .modify) {c : Nat} {y : Authority} (hc : s.A[c]? = some y)
    (hya : y.active = true) (hlt : pl.internal < c)
    (hfp : ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P pl.storage) :
    y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe := by
  obtain ⟨hact, -, hus, hsub, hall⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw (s.P.length - pl.storage + 1) pl.storage (by omega)
    hus.lt
  have hli : l ∈ xi.footprint := by have := hsub l hl; simpa [S3.afp, hxi] using this
  have hxa : xi.active = true := by
    obtain ⟨z, hz, za⟩ := hact; rw [hxi] at hz; cases hz; exact za
  have hly : l ∈ y.footprint := (hfp l).2 hl
  have hz : pl.internal ∈ s.ancs c := Decidable.byContradiction fun hn => by
    have hn2 : c ∉ s.ancs pl.internal := fun h => absurd (chain_lt h) (by omega)
    have := hi1 pl.internal c xi y l (by omega) hxi hc hxa hya hli hly hn hn2
    rw [hmi] at this; cases this.1
  have hdesc := hall l hl
  cases hm : y.mode with
  | modify =>
    rw [effective_none_of_desc_modify hc hya hly hm hz] at hdesc; exact hdesc.elim
  | observe =>
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    cases m with
    | observe => rfl
    | modify => exact absurd hdesc (not_allows_modify_of_desc hc hya hly hz)

/-- After `endUse p` (MM-03.3 §3, O12), a derived authority covering exactly the leaves of `p` is
inactive: its precondition requires it held within `p` or by a holder that dies
(`EndUseAccessOK`). -/
theorem endUse_kills {k : K} {s : S3} {p x : Nat} {y : Authority} (hw : WF3 s)
    (hpre : EndUsePre k s p) (hy : s.A[x]? = some y) (hor : y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none)
    (hfp : ∀ l, l ∈ y.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P p) : ¬ (endUseEff s p).Active x := by
  rintro ⟨y', hy', ya'⟩
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw (s.P.length - p + 1) p (by omega) hpre.1.lt
  have e1 : (endUseEff s p).A[x]? = ((s.A[x]?).map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y).map
      (fun y => if HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder then y else { y with active := false }) := by
    show (cleanup (endUseS s p)).A[x]? = _
    rw [cleanup_get, endUseS_get]
  rw [e1, hy] at hy'
  simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hy'
  subst hy'
  have hacc := hpre.2.2.1 x (List.mem_range.2 (lt_of_getElem? hy))
  simp only [EndUseAccessOK, hy, OptP] at hacc
  by_cases hh : heldIn s.P p y.holder
  · simp only [hh, ↓reduceIte] at ya'; split at ya' <;> simp at ya'
  · simp only [hh, ↓reduceIte] at ya'
    split at ya'
    · rename_i hlive
      rcases hacc ya' (hor ya') (.inl ⟨l, (hfp l).2 hl, .inl hl⟩) with h | h
      · exact hh h
      · exact h hlive
    · simp at ya'

theorem pinv_kernel {k : K} {ps : PS} {s' : S3} (hwf : PoolWF ps) (hns : NoStale ps)
    (hce : CompExcl ps) (h : Step k ps.s s') :
    PoolWF { ps with s := s' } ∧ NoStale { ps with s := s' } ∧ CompExcl { ps with s := s' } :=

/-! ## `PoolInv` is not preserved (material §4, `pool_inv_preserved`)

Two reached runs, kept as counterexamples. In both, a frame has an allocator 0, the pool value 1
and leaves for handles; the storage allocated by 0 for the pool value has two entries, and its root
authority, held by the pool value, is `internal`; entry 0 is allocated (handle `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`) and
resolved `Modify`. -/

namespace PoolInvCex

/-- Pool value 1, handle leaf 2, storage 3 with entries 4 and 5, `internal` 3; companion 4 and entry
authority 5 on the place 4 of entry 0. -/
def ops : List Op :=
  [.enter [] [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)], .write 0 [0], .write 1 [1],
    .alloc 0 1 [(none, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0), (some 3, none, 0)], .newPool 3 3,
    .allocSlot 0 0 2, .resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify]

def s0 : PS := (prun K0 (PS.init []) ops).getD (PS.init [])

/-- The program derives from the companion 4 an authority 6, `Modify`, on the place 5 of entry 1,
which is free (MM-03.3 §3, O1: accepted by the kernel). -/
def s1 : PS := (pexec K0 s0 (.derive 4 5 .modify)).getD s0

/-- The pool of `s0` and `s1`. -/
def pl : Pool := ⟨0, 3, 3, [⟨4, 0, true⟩, ⟨5, 0, false⟩]⟩

theorem reach0 : PReach K0 [] s0 := prun_init (by decide) (some_getD (by decide))

theorem step01 : PStep K0 s0 s1 := pexec_step (some_getD (by decide))

end PoolInvCex

/-- `pool_inv_preserved` (material §4) is false for `PoolInv` read literally: from a reached state
where it holds, a kernel `derive` from the companion (MM-03.3 §3, O1) gives an active authority
derived from the companion on a free entry (second clause) that is no entry authority (third
clause). The first clause still holds. -/
theorem pool_inv_not_preserved : ∃ ps ps', PReach K0 [] ps ∧ PoolInv ps ∧ PStep K0 ps ps' ∧
    ¬ PoolInv ps' :=
  ⟨_, _, PoolInvCex.reach0, by decide, PoolInvCex.step01, by decide⟩

/-- The clauses of `PoolInv` in the counterexample after the `derive`: the pool is live, entries
disjoint, the second and third clauses false. -/
theorem pool_inv_cex_clauses :
    PoolInvCex.s1.pools = [PoolInvCex.pl] ∧ PoolInvCex.s1.s.Active 3 ∧
    PoolInvDisj PoolInvCex.s1 PoolInvCex.pl ∧ ¬ PoolInvGen PoolInvCex.s1 PoolInvCex.pl ∧
    ¬ PoolInvDesc PoolInvCex.s1 PoolInvCex.pl := by decide

namespace PoolInvCex2

/-- Pool value 1, handle leaf 2, caller leaf 3, storage 4 with entries 5 and 6, `internal` 4;
companion 5 and entry authority 6 on the place 5 of entry 0; the caller derives 7 on its leaf 3 and
calls a frame with the parameters 6 and 7 (G1 holds: the companion is held by the caller). -/
def ops : List Op :=
  [.enter [] [(none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0), (none, none, 0)], .write 0 [0],
    .write 1 [1], .alloc 0 1 [(none, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0), (some 4, none, 0)],
    .newPool 4 4, .allocSlot 0 0 2, .resolve 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩ .modify, .derive 3 3 .modify,
    .enter [6, 7] []]

def s0 : PS := (prun K0 (PS.init []) ops).getD (PS.init [])

/-- The callee derives 8, `Modify`, from the entry authority 6 on the place 5 of entry 0. -/
def s1 : PS := (pexec K0 s0 (.derive 6 5 .modify)).getD s0

/-- The callee stores 8 into the caller leaf 3 (MM-03.3 §3, O8). -/
def s2 : PS := (pexec K0 s1 (.store 8 3)).getD s1

/-- `exitFrame` (O7): the entry authority 6 dies with the callee; 8 survives in the leaf 3 and is
re-attached to its first surviving ancestor, the companion 5. -/
def s3 : PS := (pexec K0 s2 .exit).getD s2

/-- The pool of these states. -/
def pl : Pool := ⟨0, 4, 4, [⟨5, 0, true⟩, ⟨6, 0, false⟩]⟩

theorem reach0 : PReach K0 [] s0 := prun_init (by decide) (some_getD (by decide))
theorem step01 : PStep K0 s0 s1 := pexec_step (some_getD (by decide))
theorem step12 : PStep K0 s1 s2 := pexec_step (some_getD (by decide))
theorem step23 : PStep K0 s2 s3 := pexec_step (some_getD (by decide))

end PoolInvCex2

/-- The third clause of `PoolInv` (read on all active descendants) fails after a `derive` from an
entry authority, the ordinary use of a resolved entry (MM-03.3 §3, O1); the second clause fails after
`exitFrame` re-attaches a surviving derivative of the entry authority to the companion (O7), with no
operation on the companion. -/
theorem pool_inv_cex_entry :
    PReach K0 [] PoolInvCex2.s0 ∧ PoolInv PoolInvCex2.s0 ∧ PStep K0 PoolInvCex2.s0 PoolInvCex2.s1 ∧
    ¬ PoolInvDesc PoolInvCex2.s1 PoolInvCex2.pl ∧
    PStep K0 PoolInvCex2.s1 PoolInvCex2.s2 ∧ PStep K0 PoolInvCex2.s2 PoolInvCex2.s3 ∧
    PoolInvGen PoolInvCex2.s2 PoolInvCex2.pl ∧ ¬ PoolInvGen PoolInvCex2.s3 PoolInvCex2.pl ∧
    PoolInvCex2.s3.pools = [PoolInvCex2.pl] ∧ PoolInvCex2.s3.s.Active 4 ∧
    PoolInvCex2.s3.s.Active 8 ∧ ¬ PoolInvCex2.s3.s.Active 6 ∧ PoolInvCex2.s3.s.org 8 = some 5 :=
  ⟨PoolInvCex2.reach0, by decide, PoolInvCex2.step01, by decide, PoolInvCex2.step12,
    PoolInvCex2.step23, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩

end Ern.HandlePool

PoolWF { ps with s := s' } ∧ NoStale { ps with s := s' } ∧ CompExcl { ps with s := s' } :=
  ⟨hwf.transport (step_keeps h) (step_fp h) rfl, hns.transport hwf (step_keeps h),
    hce.transport hwf (step_keeps h)⟩

theorem pinv_newPool {ps ps' : PS} {st i : Nat} (hwf : PoolWF ps) (hns : NoStale ps)
    (hce : CompExcl ps) (h : NewPoolStep st i ps (.ok ps')) :
    PoolWF ps' ∧ NoStale ps' ∧ CompExcl ps' := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  obtain ⟨-, hu, hint, -⟩ := hpre
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hwf
  have mem : ∀ pl ∈ ps.pools, pl ∈ (newPoolEff ps st i).pools := fun pl hpl =>
    List.mem_append_left _ hpl
  refine ⟨⟨fun pl hpl => ?_, ?_, fun pl hpl => ?_, fun r hr => ?_⟩, fun r hr e he ha => ?_, hce⟩
  · rcases List.mem_append.1 hpl with hpl | hpl
    · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (h1 pl hpl)
    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hpl]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self _
  · simp only [newPoolEff, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]
    refine List.nodup_append.2 ⟨h2, by simp, fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩
    rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hb]
    obtain ⟨pl, hpl, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 ha
    exact Nat.ne_of_lt (h1 pl hpl)
  · rcases List.mem_append.1 hpl with hpl | hpl
    · exact h3 pl hpl
    · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hpl]
      obtain ⟨y, hy, -, hm, -⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hint
      refine ⟨optP_false_iff.2 ⟨y, hy, hm⟩, hu.lt, fun sl hsl => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hsl
      exact (mem_kids.1 hq).1
  · obtain ⟨pl, hpl, rest⟩ := h4 r hr
    exact ⟨pl, mem pl hpl, rest⟩
  · obtain ⟨pl, hpl, rest⟩ := hns r hr e he ha
    exact ⟨pl, mem pl hpl, rest⟩

theorem pinv_allocSlot {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} {j via dst : Nat} (hwf : PoolWF ps)
    (hns : NoStale ps) (hce : CompExcl ps) (h : AllocSlotStep k j via dst ps (.ok ps')) :
    PoolWF ps' ∧ NoStale ps' ∧ CompExcl ps' := by
  cases h with
  | @ok pl i sl hpj _ hff hsl =>
    have hshape := map_set_same Pool.shape hpj (setSlot_shape (x := { sl with live := true }) hsl rfl)
    refine ⟨hwf.transport (.same rfl) (.same rfl) hshape, fun r hr e he ha => ?_,
      hce.transport hwf (s' := write3Eff ps.s [dst]) (.same rfl)⟩
    obtain ⟨pl0, hpl0, hid, sl0, hs0, hg, hlv⟩ := hns r hr e he ha
    by_cases hp : pl0 = pl
    · subst hp
      refine ⟨_, mem_set_self' hpj, hid, ?_⟩
      by_cases hi : e.2.1 = i
      · rw [hi, hsl] at hs0; cases hs0
        rw [firstFree_free hff hsl] at hlv; cases hlv
      · exact ⟨sl0, by simp only [setSlot]; rw [getElem?_set_ne' hi]; exact hs0, hg, hlv⟩
    · exact ⟨pl0, mem_set_of_ne hpj hpl0 hp, hid, sl0, hs0, hg, hlv⟩

....
theorem pinv_freeSlot {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} {j via : Nat} {h : Handle} (hw : WF3 ps.s)
    (hwf : PoolWF ps) (hns : NoStale ps) (hce : CompExcl ps)
    (hst : FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.ok ps')) : PoolWF ps' ∧ NoStale ps' ∧ CompExcl ps' := by
  cases hst with
  | @ok pl sl hpj _ _ hsl _ hE =>
    have hstep : Step k ps.s (endUseEff ps.s sl.place) := .kernel (.endUse (Guarded.ok hE))
    have hk := step_keeps hstep
    have hshape := map_set_same Pool.shape hpj
      (setSlot_shape (x := ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) hsl rfl)
    refine ⟨hwf.transport hk (step_fp hstep) hshape, fun r hr e he ha => ?_,
      hce.transport hwf hk⟩
    have hpl : pl ∈ ps.pools := List.mem_of_getElem? hpj
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hc, hen⟩ := hwf.2.2.2 r hr
    obtain ⟨_, _, ho⟩ := hen e he
    obtain ⟨y, hy, -⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 ho
    obtain ⟨pl0, hpl0, hid, sl0, hs0, hg, hlv⟩ := hns r hr e he (hk.active (lt_of_getElem? hy) ha)
    by_cases hp : pl0 = pl
    · subst hp
      refine ⟨_, mem_set_self' hpj, hid, ?_⟩
      by_cases hi : e.2.1 = h.slot
      · exfalso
        obtain ⟨pl1, hpl1, hid1, -, -, -, hen1⟩ := hwf.2.2.2 r hr
        have e1 : pl1 = pl0 := eq_of_id_eq hwf.2.1 hpl1 hpl0 (hid1.trans hid.symm)
        subst e1
        obtain ⟨sl1, hs1, ho1⟩ := hen1 e he
        rw [hi, hsl] at hs1; cases hs1
        obtain ⟨y1, hy1, hfp1, hor1⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 ho1
        exact endUse_kills hw hE hy1 hor1 hfp1 ha
      · exact ⟨sl0, by simp only [setSlot]; rw [getElem?_set_ne' hi]; exact hs0, hg, hlv⟩
    · exact ⟨pl0, mem_set_of_ne hpj hpl0 hp, hid, sl0, hs0, hg, hlv⟩

/-- Every pool step keeps the invariants of the pool layer. -/
theorem pstep_inv {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} (hw : WF3 ps.s) (hi1 : I1 ps.s) (hwf : PoolWF ps)
    (hns : NoStale ps) (hce : CompExcl ps) (h : PStep k ps ps') :
    PoolWF ps' ∧ NoStale ps' ∧ CompExcl ps' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel h => exact pinv_kernel hwf hns hce h
  | newPool h => exact pinv_newPool hwf hns hce h
  | allocSlot h => exact pinv_allocSlot hwf hns hce h
  | resolve h => exact pinv_resolve hw hi1 hwf hns hce h
  | resolveMany h => exact pinv_resolveMany hw hi1 hwf hns hce h
  | unresolve h => exact pinv_unresolve (k := k) hwf hns hce h
  | freeSlot h => exact pinv_freeSlot hw hwf hns hce h

/-- Invariants of the states reached with pool steps (material §4), under `DDSound k`
(MM-03.3.8): the kernel state is reached (`pReach_reachable`), the pool layer is well formed,
no entry authority is stale and the companions are exclusive. -/
theorem pReach_inv {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {ps : PS}
    (h : PReach k statics ps) :
    Reachable k statics ps.s ∧ PoolWF ps ∧ NoStale ps ∧ CompExcl ps := by
  induction h with
  | init hsh =>
    refine ⟨.init hsh, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> simp [PS.init, NoStale, CompExcl]
  | step _ hs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hr, hwf, hns, hce⟩ := ih
    obtain ⟨hw, hinv, -⟩ := reachable_invariants hdd hr
    exact ⟨reachable_steps hr (pstep_steps hw hinv.1.2.2.1 hs),
      pstep_inv hw hinv.1.1 hwf hns hce hs⟩

/-! ## Entries of a pool are disjoint parts of its storage (`PoolInv`, first clause) -/

theorem chain_total {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ n i, i < n → ∀ a b, a ∈ i :: chain org i →
    b ∈ i :: chain org i → a = b ∨ a ∈ chain org b ∨ b ∈ chain org a
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
...
  | _ :: _, i + 1, j + 1, _, hp, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at h₁ h₂
    exact congrArg (· + 1) (index_inj_of_lt (List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).2 h₁ h₂)

/-- First clause of `PoolInv` (material §4) for every pool: two distinct entries have disjoint
footprints, and every entry lies within the storage. -/
def EntriesDisjoint (ps : PS) : Prop :=
  ∀ pl ∈ ps.pools, (∀ (i₁ i₂ : Nat) (sl₁ sl₂ : Slot), i₁ ≠ i₂ → pl.slots[i₁]? = some sl₁ →
    pl.slots[i₂]? = some sl₂ → ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl₁.place, l ∉ footprint ps.s.P sl₂.place) ∧
    ∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl.place, l ∈ footprint ps.s.P pl.storage

theorem EntriesDisjoint.transport {ps : PS} {s' : S3} {pools' : List Pool} (h : EntriesDisjoint ps)
    (hwf : PoolWF ps) (hf : FpStable ps.s s') (hp : pools'.map Pool.shape = ps.pools.map Pool.shape) :
    EntriesDisjoint ⟨s', pools', ps.nId, ps.res⟩ := by
  intro pl' hpl'
  obtain ⟨pl, hpl, e⟩ := shape_mem hp.symm hpl'
  obtain ⟨hd, hin⟩ := h pl hpl
  obtain ⟨-, hst, hsl⟩ := hwf.2.2.1 pl hpl
  have e' := e; simp only [Pool.shape, Prod.mk.injEq] at e'
  have fp : ∀ q < ps.s.P.length, ∀ l, l ∈ footprint s'.P q ↔ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P q := hf.2
  refine ⟨fun i₁ i₂ sl₁' sl₂' hne h₁ h₂ l hl₁ hl₂ => ?_, fun sl' hsl' l hl => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨sl₁, h₁', p₁⟩ := shape_slot e h₁
    obtain ⟨sl₂, h₂', p₂⟩ := shape_slot e h₂
    rw [← p₁] at hl₁; rw [← p₂] at hl₂
    have hm₁ := hsl sl₁ (List.mem_of_getElem? h₁')
    have hm₂ := hsl sl₂ (List.mem_of_getElem? h₂')
    exact hd i₁ i₂ sl₁ sl₂ hne h₁' h₂' l ((fp _ hm₁ l).1 hl₁) ((fp _ hm₂ l).1 hl₂)
  · obtain ⟨sl, hs, p⟩ := shape_place e.symm hsl'
    rw [← p] at hl
    rw [← e'.2.1]
    exact (fp _ hst l).2 (hin sl hs l ((fp _ (hsl sl hs) l).1 hl))

/-- `EntriesDisjoint` holds on every reached state (material §4, `PoolInv` first clause): the
entries of `newPool` are the children of the storage, and footprints do not change. -/
theorem pool_entries_disjoint {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {ps : PS}
    (h : PReach k statics ps) : EntriesDisjoint ps := by
  induction h with
  | init => intro pl hpl; simp [PS.init] at hpl
  | step hr hs ih =>
    rename_i ps ps'
    obtain ⟨hreach, hwf, -⟩ := pReach_inv hdd hr
    obtain ⟨hw, hinv, -⟩ := reachable_invariants hdd hreach
    have hss := pstep_steps hw hinv.1.2.2.1 hs
    cases hs with
    | kernel h => exact ih.transport hwf (step_fp h) rfl
    | @newPool ps' st i h =>
      obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
      intro pl hpl
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hpl with hpl | hpl
      · exact ih pl hpl
      · rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hpl]
        have hk : (kids ps.s.P st).Pairwise (· < ·) := (range_pairwise_lt _).filter _
        refine ⟨fun i₁ i₂ sl₁ sl₂ hne h₁ h₂ => ?_, fun sl hsl l hl => ?_⟩
        · simp only [List.getElem?_map] at h₁ h₂
          cases g₁ : (kids ps.s.P st)[i₁]? with
          | none => rw [g₁] at h₁; cases h₁
          | some q₁ =>
            cases g₂ : (kids ps.s.P st)[i₂]? with
            | none => rw [g₂] at h₂; cases h₂
            | some q₂ =>
              rw [g₁] at h₁; rw [g₂] at h₂
              simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at h₁ h₂; subst h₁ h₂
              exact kids_disjoint hw (List.mem_of_getElem? g₁) (List.mem_of_getElem? g₂)
                fun e => hne (index_inj_of_lt hk g₁ (by simp only at e; rw [e]; exact g₂))
        · obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hsl
          obtain ⟨hql, hpq⟩ := mem_kids.1 hq
          exact footprint_sub hw ⟨hql, .inr (by
            rw [chain_cons hpq (hw.parent_lt hpq).1]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)⟩ hl
    | allocSlot h =>
      cases h with
      | @ok pl i sl hpj _ _ hsl =>
        exact ih.transport hwf (.same rfl)
          (map_set_same Pool.shape hpj (setSlot_shape (x := { sl with live := true }) hsl rfl))
    | resolve h => cases h with | ok => exact ih.transport hwf hss.fp rfl
    | resolveMany h => cases h with | ok => exact ih.transport hwf hss.fp rfl
    | unresolve h => cases h with | ok => exact ih.transport hwf hss.fp rfl
    | freeSlot h =>
      cases h with
      | @ok pl sl hpj _ _ hsl _ _ =>
        exact ih.transport hwf hss.fp
          (map_set_same Pool.shape hpj (setSlot_shape (x := ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) hsl rfl))

/-! ## Theorems of the material (§4) -/

/-- `pool_resolve_stale_fails` (material §4, generation): with the right of the pool value, a handle
whose generation differs from that of its entry fails, state unchanged. -/
theorem pool_resolve_stale_fails {ps : PS} {j : Nat} {pl : Pool} {h : Handle} {m : Mode}
    {sl : Slot} (hp : ps.pools[j]? = some pl) (hR : ResolveRight ps.s pl m)
    (hsl : pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl) (hg : sl.gen ≠ h.gen) :
    ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps) :=
  .fail hp hR fun ⟨_, ho⟩ => by rw [hsl] at ho; exact hg ho.1

/-- `pool_resolve_other_pool_fails` (material §4, identity of the pool): with the right of the pool
value, a handle of another pool fails, state unchanged. -/
theorem pool_resolve_other_pool_fails {ps : PS} {j : Nat} {pl : Pool} {h : Handle} {m : Mode}
    (hp : ps.pools[j]? = some pl) (hR : ResolveRight ps.s pl m) (hid : h.id ≠ pl.id) :
    ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps) :=
  .fail hp hR fun ⟨e, _⟩ => hid e

/-- A failed resolution leaves the state unchanged (material §4, `resolve`: "`fail` (état
inchangé)"). -/
theorem pool_resolve_fail_unchanged {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {h : Handle} {m : Mode}
    (hst : ResolveStep j h m ps (.fail ps')) : ps' = ps := by
  cases hst; rfl

/-- `pool_no_stale_access` (material §4): on every reached state, an active entry authority carries
the current generation of its entry, and the entry is live. -/
theorem pool_no_stale_access {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {ps : PS}
    (h : PReach k statics ps) : NoStale ps :=
  (pReach_inv hdd h).2.2.1

/-- `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive` (material §4): on every reached state, whatever the sequence of
`resolve`, `resolveMany`, `release`, `store`, `transfer` and `unresolve` (and every other step of
`PReach`), an active `Modify` companion of a pool is the only active companion of that pool: at
most one active `Modify` companion, and then no active `Observe` companion. -/
theorem pool_resolve_modify_exclusive {k : K} (hdd : DDSound k) {statics : Statics} {ps : PS}
    (h : PReach k statics ps) : ∀ r₁ ∈ ps.res, ∀ r₂ ∈ ps.res, r₁.pool = r₂.pool →
      ps.s.Active r₁.comp → ps.s.Active r₂.comp → r₁.mode = .modify → r₁.comp = r₂.comp := by
  intro r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp ha₁ ha₂ hm
  refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hne => ?_
  have := (pReach_inv hdd h).2.2.2 r₁ hr₁ r₂ hr₂ hp hne ha₁ ha₂
  rw [hm] at this; cases this.1

/-- `pool_resolveMany_atomic` (material §4): a failed `resolveMany` creates no authority and
leaves the state unchanged; an accepted one creates the companion and all the entry authorities
in one step. -/
theorem pool_resolveMany_atomic {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {hs : List Handle} {m : Mode} :
    (ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.fail ps') → ps' = ps) ∧
    (ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok ps') → ∃ pl, ps.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ BatchOK pl hs ∧
      ps'.s = resolveManyS ps.s pl hs m ∧ ps'.s.A.length = ps.s.A.length + 1 + hs.length) := by
  refine ⟨fun h => by cases h; rfl, fun h => ?_⟩
  cases h with
  | @ok pl hp _ hB _ =>
    refine ⟨pl, hp, hB, rfl, ?_⟩
    simp only [resolveManyS, splitEff, deriveEff, S3.addAuth, batchRegions, List.length_append,
      List.length_map, List.length_cons, List.length_nil]

/-- `pool_resolveMany_distinct` (material §4, dynamic distinctness): with the right of the pool
value, two handles of a batch designating the same entry make `resolveMany` fail; an accepted batch
designates pairwise distinct entries. -/
theorem pool_resolveMany_distinct {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} {j : Nat} {pl : Pool} {hs : List Handle}
    {m : Mode} :
    (ps.pools[j]? = some pl → ResolveRight ps.s pl m → ¬ (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup →
      ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.fail ps)) ∧
    (ResolveManyStep k j hs m ps (.ok ps') → (hs.map (·.slot)).Nodup) := by
  refine ⟨fun hp hR hd => .fail hp hR fun hB => hd hB.2, fun h => ?_⟩
  cases h with
  | ok _ _ hB _ => exact hB.2

/-- `pool_freeSlot_ends_content` (material §4): after `freeSlot`, the kernel state is the result of
an accepted `endUse` of the entry (MM-03.3 §3, O12), whose leaves are `Uninit`, and the entry is
free with its generation incremented. -/
theorem pool_freeSlot_ends_content {k : K} {ps ps' : PS} {j via : Nat} {h : Handle}
    (hst : FreeSlotStep k j via h ps (.ok ps')) :
    ∃ pl sl, ps.pools[j]? = some pl ∧ pl.slots[h.slot]? = some sl ∧
      EndUseStep k sl.place ps.s (.ok ps'.s) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl.place, ps'.s.I l = .uninit) ∧
      ps'.pools[j]? = some (setSlot pl h.slot ⟨sl.place, sl.gen + 1, false⟩) := by
  cases hst with
  | @ok pl sl hp _ _ hsl _ hE =>
    refine ⟨pl, sl, hp, hsl, Guarded.ok hE, fun l hl => ?_, getElem?_set_eq' hp⟩
    show (cleanup (endUseS ps.s sl.place)).I l = .uninit
    simp [cleanup, endUseS, hl]

/-! ## `PoolInv` read literally (material §4) -/

/-- Second clause of `PoolInv` (material §4), literally, for the pool `pl`: every active authority
derived from a companion of the pool and covering a leaf of an entry "porte la génération courante
de l'entrée": it is, or descends from, an entry authority of that entry tagged with its current
generation; and the entry is live. -/
def PoolInvGen (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ ps.res, r.pool = pl.id → ∀ j ∈ List.range ps.s.A.length, ps.s.Active j →
    r.comp ∈ ps.s.ancs j → ∀ i ∈ List.range pl.slots.length,
      (∃ l ∈ ps.s.afp j, l ∈ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i)) →
      OptP (pl.slots[i]?) (fun sl => sl.live = true ∧ ∃ e ∈ r.entries, e.2.1 = i ∧
        e.2.2 = sl.gen ∧ (e.1 = j ∨ e.1 ∈ ps.s.ancs j)) False

instance (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (PoolInvGen ps pl) := by
  unfold PoolInvGen; infer_instance

/-- Third clause of `PoolInv` (material §4), literally, for the pool `pl`: "toute compagne active a
au plus les autorités d'entrée de sa résolution pour descendants", read on active descendants. -/
def PoolInvDesc (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Prop :=
  ∀ r ∈ ps.res, r.pool = pl.id → ps.s.Active r.comp → ∀ j ∈ List.range ps.s.A.length,
    ps.s.Active j → r.comp ∈ ps.s.ancs j → j ∈ r.entries.map (·.1)

instance (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (PoolInvDesc ps pl) := by
  unfold PoolInvDesc; infer_instance

/-- First clause of `PoolInv` (material §4) for the pool `pl`: entries pairwise disjoint and within
the storage. -/
def PoolInvDisj (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Prop :=
  (∀ i₁ ∈ List.range pl.slots.length, ∀ i₂ ∈ List.range pl.slots.length, i₁ ≠ i₂ →
    ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i₁), l ∉ footprint ps.s.P (slotPlace pl i₂)) ∧
  ∀ sl ∈ pl.slots, ∀ l ∈ footprint ps.s.P sl.place, l ∈ footprint ps.s.P pl.storage

instance (ps : PS) (pl : Pool) : Decidable (PoolInvDisj ps pl) := by
  unfold PoolInvDisj; infer_instance

/-- `PoolInv` of the material (§4), literally, for every live pool (`internal` active): the three
clauses `PoolInvDisj`, `PoolInvGen` and `PoolInvDesc`. -/
def PoolInv (ps : PS) : Prop :=
  ∀ pl ∈ ps.pools, ps.s.Active pl.internal →
    PoolInvDisj ps pl ∧ PoolInvGen ps pl ∧ PoolInvDesc ps pl

instance (ps : PS) : Decidable (PoolInv ps) := by unfold PoolInv; infer_instance

/-- An arena entry (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3; F1): `storage` is the place of the administered storage;
`internal` is the authority that administers it, named by `newArena` (F1); `available` and
`issued` are the logical state of §6, `issued` mapping each issued region to the issued block.
The arena value is not a field: it is the place that holds `internal` (F1), which follows
transfers (A4). The anchor of §6 is not a field either: dependents anchor on the blocks (A10). -/
structure Arena where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq

/-- State `S3 = (F, P, I, A, D)` (MM-03.3 §1), without component `M` (pass-1 arbitrage 1).
`nF` is the next frame identity, so that an exited frame is never reused. `D q` lists the
anchors of place `q`, each an authority identity (pass-1 arbitrage 2). `dead q`: the place is
logically dead (A6, `endUse` and `free`); `freed q`: its storage was released by `free` (A6);
`pin l`: leaf `l` is dynamically pinned (A8). `arenas`: the arena entries registered by
`newArena` (D3). `callParams f`: the parameters given to frame `f` by `enterFrame`, a ghost record
(F6): set by `enterFrame`, never modified, read by no operation. -/
structure S3 where
  F : Frames
  nF : Nat
  P : List Place
  I : Nat → InitSt
  A : List Authority
  D : Nat → List Nat
  dead : Nat → Bool
  freed : Nat → Bool
  pin : Nat → Bool
  arenas : List Arena
  callParams : Nat → List Nat

/-- Contracts `K` (MM-03.3.8) for an execution. Types are a representation choice: regions as
lists of leaves; `SharedMutable`, `Pinned` and `ExternalDone` on leaves; `Deallocable p` and
`FreeCompat p auth` for `free` (A6); `Satisfiable provider shape s` for `alloc` (B5; C9: it
depends on the current state `s`, with the shape encoded as the locals of `enterFrame`, C6).
`Invalidates` is removed (B9). The obligations of each contract are named hypotheses of theorems, never
fields. -/
structure K where
  DeclaredDisjoint : List Nat → List Nat → Prop
  SharedMutable : Nat → Prop
  Pinned : Nat → Prop
  ExternalDone : Nat → Prop
  Deallocable : Nat → Prop
  FreeCompat : Nat → Nat → Prop
  Satisfiable : Nat → List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) → S3 → Prop

/-- Obligation of `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8): a declaration never covers two regions that
really overlap. -/
def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'

/-- `origin` link of the authority with index `i` (MM-03.3.4). -/
def S3.org (s : S3) (i : Nat) : Option Nat := (s.A[i]?).bind (·.origin)

/-- Strict ancestors of authority `i` along `origin`: `i` descends from each (MM-03.3.5). -/
def S3.ancs (s : S3) (i : Nat) : List Nat := chain s.org i

/-- Effective anchor of an anchor `x` (C1): the root of its chain of origins (`RootChain`), the
last element of `x :: s.ancs x`. -/
def S3.effAnchor (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Nat := (s.ancs x).getLastD x

/-- Active authority, that is, valid anchor (pass-1 arbitrage 2). -/
def S3.Active (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Prop := ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true

instance (s : S3) (x : Nat) : Decidable (s.Active x) :=
  match h : s.A[x]? with
  | some y => if hy : y.active = true then isTrue ⟨y, h, hy⟩
    else isFalse fun ⟨y', h', hy'⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'; exact hy hy'
  | none => isFalse fun ⟨_, h', _⟩ => by rw [h] at h'; cases h'

....

/-! ## Exercisable authorities (A2, B2) -/

/-- `s.ExercisableAt a m` (B2): authority `a` is exercisable at mode `m` when `m` does not exceed its
mode and it is held by the current frame, or held by a place `p` such that an authority
exercisable at mode `m` has an effective mode permitting `m` on the whole footprint of `p`. The
authority is active: the rights of a released authority cannot be exercised (MM-03.3 §3, O3).
Inductive, so no cycle justifies a right. -/
inductive S3.ExercisableAt (s : S3) : Nat → Mode → Prop where
  | base {a : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true → m.le y.mode →
      y.holder = .frame s.top → S3.ExercisableAt s a m
  | held {a p b : Nat} {m : Mode} {y : Authority} : s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
      m.le y.mode → y.holder = .place p → S3.ExercisableAt s b m →
      (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) → S3.ExercisableAt s a m

/-- One step of `ExercisableAt · m`, read on a Boolean premise. -/
def exR (s : S3) (m : Mode) (E : Nat → Bool) (a : Nat) : Bool :=
  match s.A[a]? with
  | some y => y.active && decide (m.le y.mode) && match y.holder with
    | .frame f => decide (f = s.top)
    | .place p => (List.range s.A.length).any fun b =>
        decide (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m) && E b
  | none => false

theorem any_congr' {α : Type} {f g : α → Bool} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ b ∈ l, f b = g b) →
    l.any f = l.any g
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.any_cons, h a (List.mem_cons_self ..),
      any_congr' fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hb)]

theorem exR_rule (s : S3) (m : Mode) : KRule s.A.length (exR s m) where
  mono p q hpq a h := by
    unfold exR at h ⊢; split at h
    · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true] at h ⊢
      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩; split at h
      · simpa using h.2
      · simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, List.any_eq_true] at h ⊢
        obtain ⟨b, hb, hc, he⟩ := h.2
        exact ⟨b, hb, hc, hpq b he⟩
    · exact h
  bound p a h := by
    unfold exR at h; split at h
    · exact lt_of_getElem? ‹_›
    · cases h
  loc p q hpq a := by
    unfold exR; split
    · congr 1; split
      · rfl
      · exact any_congr' fun b hb => by rw [hpq b (List.mem_range.1 hb)]
    · rfl

theorem exercisableAt_of_kiter (s : S3) (m : Mode) :
    ∀ k a, kiter (exR s m) k a = true → s.ExercisableAt a m
  | 0, _, h => by simp [kiter] at h
  | k + 1, a, h => by
    simp only [kiter, exR] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i y hy
      simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨⟨ha, hm⟩, h⟩ := h
      split at h
      · rename_i f hf; exact .base hy ha hm (by simp at h; rw [hf, h])
      · rename_i p hp
        simp only [List.any_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨b, -, hc, hb⟩ := h
        exact .held hy ha hm hp (exercisableAt_of_kiter s m k b hb) hc
    · cases h

theorem exR_base {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode)
    (hf : y.holder = .frame s.top) : exR s m E a = true := by
  unfold exR; rw [hy]; simp [ha, hm, hf]

theorem exR_held {s : S3} {m : Mode} {E : Nat → Bool} {a p b : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[a]? = some y) (ha : y.active = true) (hm : m.le y.mode) (hp : y.holder = .place p)
    (hb : b < s.A.length) (hc : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P p, Allows (effective s b l) m)
    (hE : E b = true) : exR s m E a = true := by
  simp only [exR, hy, ha, hp, Bool.true_and, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    List.any_eq_true, List.mem_range]
  exact ⟨hm, b, hb, hc, hE⟩

theorem exercisableAt_iff {s : S3} {a : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    s.ExercisableAt a m ↔ kiter (exR s m) (s.A.length + 1) a = true := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, exercisableAt_of_kiter s m _ a⟩
  induction h with
  | base hy ha hm hf => exact exR_base hy ha hm hf
  | held hy ha hm hp hb hc ih =>
    rw [← kiter_fix (exR_rule s _)]
    have hb' := kiter_bound (exR_rule s _) _ _ ih
    exact exR_held hy ha hm hp hb' hc ih

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (s.ExercisableAt a m) :=
  decidable_of_iff _ exercisableAt_iff.symm

/-- The current frame has an authority exercisable at mode `m` whose effective mode permits `m` on
every leaf of `q` (B2: an operation requires the mode it requests). -/
def HasRight (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ a ∈ List.range s.A.length, s.ExercisableAt a m ∧
    ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m

instance (s : S3) (m : Mode) (q : Nat) : Decidable (HasRight s m q) := by
  unfold HasRight; infer_instance

/-! ## Outcomes and guarded relations (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- `Outcome3` (MM-03.3 §3): `ok` with the new state, or `reject`, refusal by the static
discipline, distinct from a defined failure of an abstraction and from `ub` of MM-02. -/
inductive Outcome3 (σ : Type) where
  | ok (s : σ)
  | reject

/-- Common form of the transition rules of MM-03.3 §3–5: `ok` with the effect when the
precondition holds, `reject` otherwise. -/
inductive Guarded {σ : Type} (Pre : Prop) (eff : σ) : Outcome3 σ → Prop where
  | ok : Pre → Guarded Pre eff (.ok eff)
  | reject : ¬ Pre → Guarded Pre eff .reject

theorem Guarded.det {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 σ}
    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

theorem Guarded.ok_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff s' : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact ⟨‹_›, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => e ▸ .ok h⟩

theorem Guarded.reject_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff .reject ↔ ¬ Pre :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; assumption, fun h => .reject h⟩

/-! ## O1 `derive` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, place, mode)` (MM-03.3 §3, O1): a new active authority with
origin `src`, footprint `footprint place`, mode `m`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, footprint s.P q, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- O1.4 (MM-03.3 §3): every existing authority stays compatible with the derived one in the
resulting state. Not a precondition of `derive`: it follows from O1.1 and O1.3 under I1
(`derive_compat_redundant`, A11). -/
def DeriveCompat (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
  ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, ∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q,
    OptP (effective (deriveEff s src q m) b p) (fun e => Compat e m) True

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (MM-03.3 §3, O1), in order: 1 active origin, exercisable at the
requested mode (B2);
place still usable (MM-03.3.1); 2 requested footprint within the origin's; 3 mode permitted by
the effective authority of the origin on each leaf. O1.4 is removed (A11): it follows from the
others under I1 (`derive_compat_redundant`). O1.5 is not restated: `derive` deactivates
nothing. -/
def DerivePre (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop :=
  s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧ s.Usable q ∧
  (∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, p ∈ s.afp src) ∧
  (∀ p ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s src p) m)

instance (s : S3) (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) : Decidable (DerivePre s src q m) := by
  unfold DerivePre; infer_instance

/-- `derive` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O1). -/
def DeriveStep (src q : Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src q m) (deriveEff s src q m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (MM-03.3 §3) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (MM-03.3 §3, O2): one derived `Modify` authority per
region, held by the current frame; the origin remains a logical authority. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p`: an active descendant of `src` in
mode `Modify` covering `p` (MM-03.3 §3, O2.4). -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (MM-03.3 §3, O2), in order: 1 the origin is an active authority,
exercisable at `Modify` (B2), with effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions; 2 regions within the available footprint
(the origin's footprint where its effective authority is present); 3 regions pairwise disjoint,
structurally (no shared leaf) or by `DeclaredDisjoint` (MM-03.3.8); 4 no region covers an
exclusive right already distributed. O2.5 is not restated: `split` changes neither `D` nor
activity. -/
def SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop :=
  s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧ (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
  rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
  (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p)

instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) := by
  unfold SplitPre; infer_instance

/-- `split` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O2). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (MM-03.3 §3, A6) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (MM-03.3 §3, O3; A6: end of a temporary access): the
authority becomes inactive. F4: an authority held by a place `q` leaves the anchors of `q` in the
same transition. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (C4): the holder is the current frame, or a place on
which the current frame has exercisable `Modify` (`HasRight`, B2). -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (MM-03.3 §3, O3), in order: 1 active authority; 2 no active
descendant; 3 no usable place has `a` as anchor, except the place that holds `a`, whose anchor
`a` is removed by the release (F4); C4: the authority is derived, an authority
without origin is rejected, and its holder is the current frame or a place on which the current
frame has exercisable `Modify` (`HolderRight`). O3.4 (guarantees of associated abstractions) is
not represented in the kernel. -/
def ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Active a ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q → (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)) ∧
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none ∧ HolderRight s y.holder) False

instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) := by unfold ReleasePre; infer_instance

/-- `release` as a relation (MM-03.3 §3, O3). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)

/-! ## `endUse` (A6) -/

/-- The value at `p` ends (A6), before releasing authorities whose holder died: the leaves of
`p` become `Uninit`; the authorities held by `p` or one of its parts are released; the anchors
of `p` and its parts are removed; the places owned by `p` or one of its parts are logically
dead. -/
def endUseS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || match s.P[q]? with
      | some pl => decide (heldIn s.P p pl.owner)
      | none => false
    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `endUse p` (A6): `endUseS`, then the authorities whose holder died are released.
No storage is released: `freed` is unchanged. -/
def endUseEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (endUseS s p)

/-- Leaves that end with the value at `p` (A6): those of `p`, and those of places that stop
being usable. -/
def EndingLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s p).Usable l)

instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (EndingLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold EndingLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Root of the value at `p` (A6, pass-1 arbitrage 2): an authority without origin covering a
leaf of `p`. -/
def IsRootOf (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  y.origin = none ∧ ∃ l ∈ footprint s.P p, l ∈ y.footprint

instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Decidable (IsRootOf s p y) := by
  unfold IsRootOf; infer_instance

/-- Authority `a` is released by the end of the value at `p` (A4, A6): it is active, and held
within `p` (released by `endUseS`) or by a holder that is not live after `endUseS` (released by
`cleanup`). Under the possession clause of `WF3`, that holder dies with `p`. -/
def EndUseReleased (s : S3) (p a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun z => z.active = true ∧
    (heldIn s.P p z.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) z.holder)) False

instance (s : S3) (p a : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseReleased s p a) := by
  unfold EndUseReleased; infer_instance

/-- Authority `j` does not block the end of the value at `p` (A6): if it is an active derived
authority on an ending leaf, or descending from an authority that the end releases
(MM-03.3 §3, O3.2), it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
def EndUseAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
    ((∃ l ∈ y.footprint, EndingLeaf s p l) ∨ ∃ a ∈ s.ancs j, EndUseReleased s p a) →
      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAccessOK s p j) := by
  unfold EndUseAccessOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Anchor `x` survives the end of the value at `p` (A6): not held within `p`, not the root of
`p`, with a holder that stays live. -/
def EndUseAnchorOK (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧ ¬ IsRootOf s p y ∧
    HolderLive (endUseS s p) y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (p x : Nat) : Decidable (EndUseAnchorOK s p x) := by
  unfold EndUseAnchorOK OptP; split <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `endUse p` (A6). Usability of the anchored places is read after the end:
a place that dies with `p` has no usable dependent afterwards. In order: `p` usable;
exercisable `Modify` on `p` (A2);
no active derived authority on an ending leaf, or descending from an authority that the end
releases (MM-03.3 §3, O3.2), held elsewhere than in `p` and staying live; no
usable place anchored on an authority held by `p`, on its root, or held by a holder that dies;
C5: no ending leaf pinned, dynamically (A8) or statically (`Pinned`), whatever `ExternalDone`
says: external obligations end only through `unpin`. The ending leaves include those of the
owned places, which die (A6). C8: `p` itself stays usable, its leaves `Uninit`. -/
def EndUsePre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, EndUseAccessOK s p j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (endUseS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ (endUseS s p).D q,
    EndUseAnchorOK s p x) ∧
  (∀ l ∈ List.range s.P.length, EndingLeaf s p l → s.pin l = false ∧ ¬ k.Pinned l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (p : Nat) :
    Decidable (EndUsePre k s p) := by
  unfold EndUsePre; infer_instance

/-- `endUse` as a relation (A6). -/
def EndUseStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (EndUsePre k s p) (endUseEff s p)

theorem endUseS_releases (s : S3) (p : Nat) : OnlyReleases s (endUseS s p) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [endUseS], fun j z hz => ?_⟩
  simp only [endUseS, List.getElem?_map] at hz
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hz; cases hz
  | some y =>
....
  | some v => footprint s.P v
  | none => []

/-- Arena invariant (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3; F1; F2). Clauses of §6: issued regions within the
administered storage (the footprint of `internal`); two simultaneously valid issued regions
disjoint; available regions disjoint from the still distributed ones; added: available regions
within the storage. Clause of A10: each emission is a `Modify` authority derived from `internal`
on its region. F2: the storage is a place of `P`, owned by anything (a local, a static, an
allocated root, a block): the ownership clause of A10 is removed. F1: `internal` is a `Modify`
authority held by a place, the arena value, and covers exactly the footprint of the storage. -/
def ArenaInv (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : Prop :=
  (∀ l ∈ ar.available, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  ar.issued.Pairwise (fun e e' => s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ ar.available) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ ar.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some ar.internal ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify) ∧
  ar.storage < s.P.length ∧
  (∃ (y : Authority) (v : Nat), s.A[ar.internal]? = some y ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧
    y.holder = .place v) ∧
  (∀ l, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P ar.storage)

/-- Right to update the metadata of the arena (A10; C6, aligned with `ProviderRight`): exercisable
`Modify` on the arena value, or an authority `via` exercisable at `Observe` (B2) with a present
effective mode on every metadata leaf, all `SharedMutable` (a `writeShared`, A9), with valid
dependencies. -/
def MetaRight (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s ar) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False ∨
  (s.ExercisableAt via .observe ∧ arenaValue s ar ≠ none ∧
    ∀ l ∈ metaLeaves s ar, effective s via l ≠ none ∧ k.SharedMutable l ∧ DepsValid s l)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (MetaRight k s ar via) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10; J1): a `Modify` block derived from `internal`
on the region, held by the destination leaf; that leaf, and it only, becomes `Init` (J1, second
bullet), so the initialisation of the arena value is unchanged unless the destination is one of its
leaves (`issue_into_arena_value`; J1, third bullet: a question of the pass-8 report); the region
leaves `available` and joins `issued`. -/
def issueEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 × Arena :=
  ({ s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some ar.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩ with
      I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l },
   { ar with
      available := ar.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
      issued := (region, s.A.length) :: ar.issued })

/-- Static preconditions of `arena.issue(region)` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right (A10); the
region lies in the storage administered by `internal`; the destination `dst` of the block is
usable, exercisable in `Modify` (A2) and holds no initialised value; J1: `dst` is a leaf
(`isLeaf`) that holds no active authority. -/
def IssueStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧ s.Active ar.internal ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp ar.internal) ∧
  s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧
  isLeaf s.P dst ∧
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst)
    True

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat)
    (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Decidable (IssueStatic k s ar via region dst) := by
  unfold IssueStatic; infer_instance

/-- The region is available (MM-03.3 §6): otherwise `issue` fails (A10). -/
def Avail (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ ar.available

instance (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail ar region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-- The abstraction has, through `internal`, effective `Modify` on the region (MM-03.3 §6:
the abstraction has the authority needed to distribute the region). The
disjointness from active emissions is removed (A11): it follows from this right
(`issue_disjoint_redundant`). -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify

instance (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s ar region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Outcomes of `issue` (A10): `ok`, defined failure `fail` with the state unchanged, `reject`
(pass-1 arbitrage 6). -/
inductive IOutcome where
  | ok (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | fail (s : S3) (ar : Arena)
  | reject

/-- `arena.issue` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10): `reject` when a static precondition fails;
`fail`, with the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable; `reject` when the region is
available but `internal` lacks the right to distribute it; G4: `reject` when the arrival state,
where the block is held by `dst`, breaks `AnchorOrderHeld`; `ok` otherwise. A failed `issue`
creates no holding relation and has no arrival state, so G4 is not checked before `fail`. -/
inductive IssueStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    IOutcome → Prop where
  | ok : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s
        (.ok (issueEff s ar region dst).1 (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
  | fail : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → ¬ Avail ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s ar)
  | reject : ¬ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noRight : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → ¬ IssueRight s ar region →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject
  | noAnchor : IssueStatic k s ar via region dst → Avail ar region → IssueRight s ar region →
      ¬ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject

/-- Determinism of `issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_det {k : K} {ar : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s : S3}
    {o₁ o₂ : IOutcome} (h₁ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₁)
    (h₂ : IssueStep k ar via region dst s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- `ok` outcome of `arena.issue` (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
theorem issue_ok_iff {k : K} {ar ar' : Arena} {via dst : Nat} {region : List Nat} {s s' : S3} :
    IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar') ↔ IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧
      Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 ∧
      (s', ar') = issueEff s ar region dst := by
  constructor
  · intro h; cases h with
    | ok h1 h2 h3 h4 => exact ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, e⟩
    have e1 := congrArg Prod.fst e; have e2 := congrArg Prod.snd e
    simp only at e1 e2; subst e1 e2; exact .ok h1 h2 h3 h4

/-- Preconditions of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10): metadata right; no active authority
derived from `internal`; no usable place anchored on `internal` or on an authority derived from
it. -/
def ResetPre (k : K) (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) : Prop :=
  MetaRight k s ar via ∧
  (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ar.internal ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
  (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, x ≠ ar.internal ∧ ar.internal ∉ s.ancs x)

instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) :
    Decidable (ResetPre k s ar via) := by
  unfold ResetPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `arena.reset()` (MM-03.3 §6; A10; J1): the whole storage becomes available, the past
emissions are forgotten; the initialisation of the arena value is unchanged (J1). -/
def resetEff (s : S3) (ar : Arena) : S3 × Arena :=
  (s, { ar with available := s.afp ar.internal, issued := [] })

/-- `arena.reset` as a relation (MM-03.3 §6; A10). -/
def ResetStep (k : K) (ar : Arena) (via : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 (S3 × Arena) → Prop :=
  Guarded (ResetPre k s ar via) (resetEff s ar)

theorem afp_addAuth_lt {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {j : Nat} (h : j < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).afp j = s.afp j := by simp only [S3.afp, addAuth_lt h]

theorem active_addAuth_iff {s : S3} {y₀ : Authority} {x : Nat} (hx : x < s.A.length) :
    (s.addAuth y₀).Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
  simp only [S3.Active, addAuth_lt hx]

/-- The disjointness of a new emission from the active ones follows from the authority of
`internal` (MM-03.3 §6; A11): an active block derived from `internal` covering a leaf takes the
effective `Modify` of `internal` away from it. -/
theorem issue_disjoint_redundant {s : S3} {ar : Arena} {region : List Nat} (hwf : WF3 s)
    (hai : ArenaInv s ar) (hm : ∀ l ∈ region, effective s ar.internal l = some .modify) :
    ∀ e ∈ ar.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ region, l ∉ e.1 := by
  intro e he ha l hl hle
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ho, hf, hmd⟩ := hai.2.2.2.2.1 e he
  obtain ⟨y', hy', ya⟩ := ha; rw [hy] at hy'; cases hy'
  have hlt := hwf.origin e.2 y ar.internal hy ho
....

/-- Preconditions of `newArena storage internal` (D3, F1, F2, J1), in order. Kept from D3: exercisable
`Modify` on `storage`; `storage` usable. F1: `internal`, named by the caller, is active, `Modify`,
exercisable at `Modify` (B2), and held by a place, the arena value; the footprint of `internal` is
the footprint of `storage`; no live arena already has `internal` as `internal`. F1 removes the
guard by place index of D3 and the kind of `internal`; F2 removes the ownership of the storage
(A10): the storage may be a local, a static, an allocated root or a block. J1: the leaves of the
arena value, the holder of `internal`, are all `Init` (`LeavesInit`). -/
def NewArenaPre (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop :=
  HasRight s .modify storage ∧ s.Usable storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true)
      False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    (∀ ar ∈ s.arenas, s.Active ar.internal → ar.internal ≠ internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True

instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaPre s storage internal) := by
  unfold NewArenaPre; infer_instance

/-- Effect of `newArena storage internal` (D3; F1): a new entry, the whole storage available,
nothing issued. -/
def newArenaEff (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with arenas := s.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, s.afp internal, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena storage internal : ok | reject` as a relation (D3; F1). -/
def NewArenaStep (storage internal : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre s storage internal) (newArenaEff s storage internal)

/-- `arena.issue` on the entry `i` of the state (MM-03.3 §6; A10; D3): the step `IssueStep` of the
recorded arena, whose new logical state is written back; a missing entry is rejected. An entry
whose `internal` is released is rejected by `IssueStatic`, which asks it active. -/
inductive IssueAt (k : K) (i via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (s : S3) :
    AOutcome → Prop where
  | ok {ar : Arena} {s' : S3} {ar' : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.ok s' ar') → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.ok (arenaSet s' i ar'))
  | fail {ar : Arena} {s' : S3} {ar' : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar →
      IssueStep k ar via region dst s (.fail s' ar') → IssueAt k i via region dst s (.fail s)
  | reject {ar : Arena} : s.arenas[i]? = some ar → IssueStep k ar via region dst s .reject →
      IssueAt k i via region dst s .reject

1:# ERN — Jalon 3, passe 1 : validation adversariale (pool de handles, MM3-H, MM23-H, options `NoLock`)
5:## État de vérification
9:| 1 `HandlePool` | 6d79960 | `Ern/HandlePool.lean` |
18:  - `HandlePool` : 734 constantes, dont 325 théorèmes ;
26:- MM3-H. Les exécutions passent par `HandlePool.prun`, une fonction d'exécution prouvée correcte (`prun_reach`). Elle rend un état atteint (`PReach`, donc `Reachable` du noyau par `pReach_reachable`). Le verdict du pas éprouvé est énoncé par la relation de son opération et décidé sur l'état atteint.
29:## (a) Table des cas
33:### MM3-H
70:| H30 | `H30` | `fail` | `fail`, état inchangé | §4, génération | Lib | handle de l'entrée réutilisée : ok |
71:| H31a | `H31a` | second reject | reject (autre entrée, handle périmé, `Observe`) | §4 | Lib | après `unresolve` : ok |
73:| H32 | `H32` | reject | reject (`borrowed`) | §4, O3.2 | Lib | après `unresolve` : ok |
74:| H33 | `H33` | reject | reject (`EffAnchorOK`) | G4 | Lib | rangement dans une valeur du cadre du pool : ok |
76:| H34b | `H34b` | `fail` | `fail` | §4, identité | Lib | sur son pool : ok |
88:| W1 | `W1` | tout ok ; `resolve` périmé `fail` ; `freeSlot` pendant résolution reject | idem | §5b | Lib | après `unresolve` : `freeSlot` ok |
89:| W2 | `W2` | accès disjoints ok ; `resolveMany` ok ; déplacement pendant la vue reject ; après ok | accès disjoints, `resolveMany` et rejet pendant la vue : comme attendu ; après libération de la vue de lecture seule : reject ; après libération de l'autorité de colonne de B (et de sa vue) : ok | §5b | Lib | (b) 3 |
100:### MM23-H (`Ern.MM23.Horrors`)
126:## (b) Écarts entre attendu et obtenu
148:## (c) Écarts connus (règle 8)
157:## (d) Statut des théorèmes de `HandlePool`
161:| `pool_resolve_stale_fails` | prouvé : génération différente, droit présent ⇒ `fail`, état inchangé (`pool_resolve_fail_unchanged`) |
162:| `pool_resolve_other_pool_fails` | prouvé |
163:| `pool_no_stale_access` | prouvé sur tout état de `PReach` sous `DDSound` : une autorité d'entrée active porte la génération courante de son entrée, qui est vivante |
164:| `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive` | prouvé sur tout état de `PReach`, qui contient **toutes** les étapes du noyau, sous `DDSound` : une compagne `Modify` active d'un pool est la seule compagne active de ce pool |
165:| `pool_resolveMany_atomic`, `pool_resolveMany_distinct` | prouvés |
166:| `pool_freeSlot_ends_content` | prouvé : l'état du noyau est le résultat d'un `endUse` accepté de l'entrée ; feuilles `Uninit` ; entrée libre, génération incrémentée |
167:| `pool_inv_preserved` | **faux** pour `PoolInv` lu littéralement (voir la liste ci-dessous) |
168:| intégration à `Reachable` | prouvée : `pReach_reachable`, chaque pas du pool est une suite de pas du noyau (`pstep_steps`), noyau inchangé |
170:Détail pour `pool_inv_preserved` :
171:- **Contre-exemple** `pool_inv_not_preserved` : `derive` du noyau depuis la compagne vers une entrée libre. L'entrée n'est pas vivante (deuxième clause) et l'autorité n'est pas une autorité d'entrée (troisième clause).
172:- **Contre-exemple** `pool_inv_cex_entry` :
175:- **Parties prouvées** : la première clause, sur tout pool (`pool_entries_disjoint`), et la deuxième pour les autorités d'entrée (`pool_no_stale_access`).
176:- La preuve d'exclusivité n'utilise pas `PoolInv`. Elle repose sur I1 et sur le mode effectif de `internal` à la création de chaque compagne (`companion_blocks`).
178:## (e) Mesure `NoLock`
197:## (f) Décisions non dictées par le matériel
199:Pool :
200:1. L'entrée de pool vit à côté de `S3` (`PS`), comme l'entrée d'arène mais hors du noyau. Les résolutions sont un registre fantôme (`Res`) portant les étiquettes de génération.
201:2. Les entrées sont les enfants du stockage, dans l'ordre des indices. `newPool storage internal` ne reçoit pas de liste d'entrées.
202:3. `allocSlot` choisit la première entrée libre.
203:4. Le « droit d'exercice de `internal` au mode `m` » de `resolve` est la précondition de `derive` de la compagne, mode effectif compris. C'est ce qui donne « quels que soient les handles » (H31a).
204:5. Un handle dont l'entrée n'existe pas : `fail`.
205:6. `freeSlot` échoue (`fail`) pour un handle périmé ou d'un autre pool seulement ; une entrée libre de même génération n'est pas un échec.
206:7. « Couvre l'entrée » (`freeSlot`) : couvre une feuille de l'entrée.
207:8. `allocSlot` reprend les conditions de destination d'`issue`. La taille d'un handle n'est pas représentée : MM-03 n'a pas de tailles.
208:9. `unresolve` reçoit la compagne. Il libère les autorités d'entrée dans l'ordre enregistré, puis la compagne, et rejette si une libération l'est (y compris celle d'une entrée déjà libérée).
209:10. `newPool` reprend `NewArenaPre` à la lettre ; sa clause 4 ne lit que les arènes.
211:12. Lecture de `PoolInv` :
216:13. « Périmé » est lu deux fois. `resolve` et `resolveMany` échouent aussi sur une entrée libre (`HandleOK`), conformément à `resolve` ; la liste d'échecs de `resolveMany` dans le matériel ne cite pas l'entrée libre. `freeSlot` ne lit que l'identité et la génération. Témoin : `pool_free_entry_handle`. `pool_no_stale_access` énonce génération courante **et** entrée vivante, plus que « aucune autorité active d'une génération périmée ».
217:14. `allocSlot` ne change pas le contenu de l'entrée ; le matériel dit qu'il « reste `Uninit` », ce qui ne vaut que si l'entrée l'était (`pool_allocSlot_content_init`, question (g) 13).
224:    - H34 : la copie du handle est la lecture d'une feuille puis l'écriture d'une autre ;
231:17. W1–W3 reçoivent la classe Lib (pool et arène) ; le matériel ne classe pas les scénarios du §5b.
243:## (g) Questions pour arbitrage
245:1. **`PoolInv`** n'est pas un invariant de l'extension ((d)). Deux voies :
246:   - restreindre l'extension : la compagne n'est pas utilisable par les opérations du noyau. Cela ne suffit pas : le ré-ancrage de `exitFrame` et la dérivation depuis l'entrée violent encore les clauses 2 et 3 (`pool_inv_cex_entry`) ;
247:   - ou réénoncer les clauses 2 et 3, par exemple sur les seules autorités d'entrée, ce que prouve `pool_no_stale_access`.
248:2. **`resolveMany Observe`** n'est jamais accepté par la construction du matériel : le `split` de la compagne exige `Modify` (O2), donc rejet sur un lot valide (`resolveMany_observe_rejected`, un exemple), `fail` sur un lot invalide, la vérification du lot venant avant. Est-ce voulu ?
249:3. **Deux pools sur le même `internal`.** `newPool` ne l'interdit pas (clause 4 de `newArena` lue à la lettre ; `pool_two_on_one_internal`). Le handle d'un pool résout alors une entrée que l'autre a libérée et réallouée, et un `freeSlot` de l'un termine le contenu d'une entrée vivante de l'autre (`pool_two_freeSlot_cross`). Symétriquement, `newArena` accepte l'`internal` d'un pool vivant (`arena_on_pool_internal`).
256:10. **Pool non vivant.** `allocSlot` et `freeSlot` n'exigent pas un pool vivant (`internal` actif), et le matériel est muet. `resolve` l'exige par le droit sur `internal`.
258:12. **`freeSlot` selon `endUse`.** Le matériel dit « reject si une précondition d'`endUse` échoue », ce que le modèle applique en entier. Deux conséquences :
259:    - sur le pool de H44, dont `internal` est un bloc d'arène, donc dérivé, détenu par la valeur pool hors de l'entrée, `freeSlot` est rejeté : `internal` est une autorité dérivée active qui couvre l'entrée hors d'elle (`EndUseAccessOK`, A6 ; `pool_freeSlot_derived_internal`). Le même motif vaut pour tout pool vivant dont `internal` dérivé est détenu hors de l'entrée ; le témoin est ce seul pool ;
260:    - le droit par `writeShared` sur des métadonnées `SharedMutable`, admis pour `freeSlot`, ne suffit pas : `endUse` demande `Modify` sur l'entrée (A2 ; `pool_freeSlot_shared_right`).
262:13. **Contenu d'une entrée allouée.** « Son contenu reste `Uninit` » suppose une entrée `Uninit` ; une entrée jamais utilisée d'un stockage écrit avant `newPool` est `Init` (`pool_allocSlot_content_init`). Faut-il que `newPool` exige un stockage `Uninit`, ou que `allocSlot` le constate ?
264:## Revue adverse
268:- **Exclusivité et fidélité du pool.** Aucun contournement de `pool_resolve_modify_exclusive` trouvé. Constats : `freeSlot` inutilisable sur un `internal` dérivé ou avec le droit `writeShared` ; pools et arènes sur un même `internal` ; double lecture de « périmé » ; contenu `Init` d'une entrée allouée ; nuance sur les lectures de la deuxième clause de `PoolInv`. Traités par des témoins (section « Observations » de `MM03.Horrors`), (d), (f) 13–14, (g) 3, 12, 13, et la docstring de `allocSlotEff`.
